superseded_engineering_source.reason: The first implementation keyed the single-symbol endpoint to len(data_map). Production data_map contains reference/market frames beyond requested tradable symbols, so prefix01 did not receive the preregistered one-symbol endpoint. Its four-path replay is therefore not an economic test of the intended mechanism and is retained only as invalid engineering-drift evidence.

mechanism: Retain the existing diversified entry ceiling by default. Lift only the existing standard portfolio diversification ceiling to the unlevered endpoint when the requested tradable universe contains one symbol or when multiple symbols genuinely compete in the same-open native buy set. Explicit strategy-specific stricter symbol caps remain binding. Simultaneous multi-symbol demand is coordinated with actual cash and native total/group/ADV constraints. Existing holdings are not sold or retargeted and queued sells create no funding credit.
